The compound is a para-disubstituted benzene ring with an ester group and a 1-propenyl group. The ester is a methyl ester (no –CH₂ signals), giving one –CH₃ singlet. The vinyl region shows one doublet and one doublet of quartets, characteristic of a –CH=CH–CH₃ group, which provides the second –CH₃ signal (a doublet). The aromatic region has two signals, consistent with a para-substituted ring (four aromatic protons). Counting atoms: aromatic C₆H₄, ester –COOCH₃ (C₂H₃O₂), and 1-propenyl –CH=CHCH₃ (C₃H₅) gives a total of C₁₁H₁₂O₂.

Answer: C
